description: Insert one bridge between adjacent exact intersections with an embedded segment graph, retaining stable split/link ancestry.
output_invariants: Detached finite canonical data; stable identity/order as specified; no partial result on failure.

behavior.validation: Exact passive Object/null-prototype records, dense ordinary arrays with own data slots, no classes/accessors/symbols/extras/coercion; proxies outside interchange. Numeric values finite binary64; booleans never numbers. Validate complete input in input-schema field order, arrays in order, then correspondence/topology structure, then exact-integer work preflight before geometric predicates or result allocation. Normalize accepted/exposed zero to +0. Inputs unchanged and all outputs deeply detached. Host allocation failure remains a host error.
behavior.environment: No RNG, clock, renderer or assets. Caller Cartesian coordinates; signed turns use algebraic counterclockwise orientation in x/y coordinates, visually clockwise when y points down. Explicit caller dt where present. p5-only initial delivery; no physical collision, source solver or other-target equivalence.
behavior.numerics: Binary64 separately rounded primitives, no FMA or reassociation. Check each computed floating arithmetic primitive finite or NUMERIC_OVERFLOW. Exact dyadic/rational predicates use existing internal/exact-rational.js without converting before classification. Existing fdlibmHypot and fdlibmAtan2 profiles for stated norms/angles. Compare IDs, topology, ordering, counters and errors exactly; analytical floating fixtures may explicitly allow absolute1e-12 relative0. No global epsilon.
behavior.topology: Node and edge records strictly ascending unique IDs; all edge endpoint IDs exist and differ. Edge orientation is retained as a,b, but connectivity is undirected: duplicate unordered endpoint pairs are INVALID_TOPOLOGY. Isolated nodes allowed. next counters exceed existing respective IDs. maxNodes>=N,maxEdges>=E or INVALID_INPUT. Distinct nodes cannot have equal exact coordinates. Original edges nonzero; edge intersections are allowed only at their shared endpoint node; adjacent collinear positive overlap is invalid. INVALID_GEOMETRY after work preflight. Candidate endpoints must differ exactly or INVALID_INPUT during static validation.
behavior.work: N=graph.nodes.length,E=graph.edges.length. Reserve exact W=N+2*E+E*E+maxEdges*maxEdges+16. Terms cover node capture, edges/candidate tests, old/final embedding predicates and bounded split/link administration; sorting and rational bit costs are not events. WORK_LIMIT before geometry. O(N+E^2+maxEdges^2) reserved predicate work; actual geometry O(E^2), O(N+E) storage. All caps count final live records, not retired IDs.
behavior.enumeration: Against old graph visit edges by ID. Collect exact closed nonparallel segment intersections along directed candidate. Parallel noncollinear miss. Any positive-length collinear candidate/edge overlap is AMBIGUOUS_OVERLAP, including a previously inserted identical connector; single-point collinear contact is allowed. Group hits by exact candidate parameter; one graph vertex with many incident edges is one hit and reuses that node. In a valid embedded graph an interior hit belongs to exactly one edge. Sort distinct hits by exact t. If fewer than2 distinct hits, return detached unchanged graph,events[],inserted false,reason INSUFFICIENT_HITS, irrespective of gapIndex. Otherwise require gapIndex<hits.length-1; failing this is dynamic INVALID_INPUT after enumeration, before output planning.
behavior.edit: Select hits gapIndex and gapIndex+1 only. Candidate t order allocates each needed new interior-hit node from nextNodeId. Endpoint hits reuse IDs without allocation. Then visit the at-most-two split old edges by stable edge ID; allocate two child edge IDs, preserving parent a->newNode->b orientation; remove parent. Emit split event with parentEdgeId,nodeId,childEdgeIds,parentT (parameter on parent a->b). Allocate connector edge last, from first selected hit node to second; emit link event. New nodes/edges are returned sorted by stable IDs. Old nodes and unaffected edges unchanged. inserted true,reason null. No stochastic choice or mutation. IDs never recycled; prospective counters above9007199254740991 fail ID_EXHAUSTED. Before constructing output require actual N+newNodeCount<=maxNodes and E+splitCount+1<=maxEdges or OUTPUT_LIMIT.
behavior.rounding: Exact hit coordinates and parentT round once to nearest-even binary64. A proper interior parent parameter rounding to0/1, a new point equal to any other output node after rounding, or a zero-length child is REPRESENTATION_COLLAPSE. Revalidate final embedded geometry after rounding using exact predicates over output binary64 values; any new forbidden contact/overlap is REPRESENTATION_COLLAPSE. No output on any failure. An already existing connector necessarily overlaps the candidate, so strict overlap error takes precedence; there is no unreachable EXISTS no-op.
behavior.native_surface: insertSegmentBridge2D(input), InsertSegmentBridge2DError; insert-segment-bridge-2d.js and package index.

errors.WORK_LIMIT: Exact declared work reservation exceeds maxWork.
errors.NUMERIC_OVERFLOW: Nonfinite checked arithmetic; no partial result.
errors.AMBIGUOUS_OVERLAP: Positive-length candidate overlap with an old edge.
errors.OUTPUT_LIMIT: Required live nodes/edges exceed explicit caps.
errors.ID_EXHAUSTED: Allocation would make an ID counter unsafe.
errors.REPRESENTATION_COLLAPSE: Rounded intersection or final graph loses exact distinctness/embedding.
